name: SpotlightCard-TS-TW
blurb: A radial spotlight follows your cursor across a dark card.
description: Card with a circular spotlight effect that tracks mouse/focus position. The spot glows with a customizable color (default white rgba). Spotlight appears on hover and focus, fading out on blur/leave.
use_when: Cards where you want subtle visual feedback that draws attention to content under the cursor.
a11y: Focus triggers the spotlight like hover does. Keyboard-navigable.
